verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe device management built into the same platform as identity. It covers lifecycle automation for Apple and Windows, setup and configuration across macOS, Windows, iOS and iPadOS, and zero-touch deployment. It also enforces custom security policies based on user and device attributes, and offboarding in Rippling triggers device actions. All of this comes from marketing pages only, with no technical depth. missing for 10: explicit evidence of remote lock/wipe, detailed enrollment documentation (e.g. ADE/Autopilot), independent or hands-on corroboration.
